Short answer

To install python-mediapipe on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add python-mediapipe. It is a 10.2 MB download (31.6 MB installed), version 1.1.0-1, licensed Apache-2.0. A cross-platform, customizable ML solutions for live and streaming media. Free and open source.

Install python-mediapipe on Omarchy

MediaPipe is a Google framework for building cross-platform, on-device machine learning pipelines — things like face, hand and pose detection, object tracking, and audio or text classification. It ships pre-trained models and cross-platform APIs (MediaPipe Tasks) so developers can add these ML features to mobile, web, and desktop apps without sending data to a server, along with tools to customize models on your own data.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add python-mediapipe
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.1.0-1:
    pacman -Qi python-mediapipe

Open and use python-mediapipe

python-mediapipe has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql python-mediapipe | grep /usr/bin/

Frequently asked questions

How do I install python-mediapipe on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add python-mediapipe. The download is 10.2 MB and it takes 31.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is python-mediapipe free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed Apache-2.0.

How do I uninstall python-mediapipe?

Run omarchy pkg drop python-mediapipe. It removes the package from your system.

What does python-mediapipe depend on?

The package declares 17 dependencies: absl-py, gcc-libs, glibc, libglvnd, opencv, opengl-driver, python-attrs, python-flatbuffers, python-matplotlib, python-numpy, python-opencv, python-pillow and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is python-mediapipe a desktop app?

No. python-mediapipe has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is python-mediapipe in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as python-mediapipe (version 1.1.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Google AI Edge makes it. Project site: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe.
